rows.claim: Thruster Actuation Kinematics is a top-level functional module: Generates controlled surge, heave, yaw and station-keeping authority underwater.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Autonomy Compute Communication is a top-level functional module: Runs mission autonomy, navigation fusion, acoustic messaging, payload logging and fail-safe states.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Subsea Energy Storage is a top-level functional module: Stores enough mission energy for roughly 8 hours before detailed drag, hotel-load and reserve calculations.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Pressure Thermal Buoyancy Interface is a top-level functional module: Manages pressure boundary support, heat rejection, buoyancy and trim interactions with seawater.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Deck Recovery And Service is a top-level functional module: Supports launch, recovery, charging, leak testing and field service without disturbing verified settings unnecessarily.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Subsea Power Distribution is a top-level functional module: Routes protected power to thrusters, mission computer, navigation sensors and payloads.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Leak Abort And Recovery Safety is a top-level functional module: Detects water ingress, over-depth risk and lost-vehicle states, then drives abort and recovery behaviour.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Navigation And Payload Sensing is a top-level functional module: Measures vehicle state, seabed-relative movement, depth and inspection payload data.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: Pressure Structure Containment is a top-level functional module: Maintains a dry electronics and battery envelope for a 300 m underwater operating target.
rows.nextAction: Accept, correct or reject the module allocation through engineering review.

rows.claim: EMC-MARINE-COMMS-REVIEW: Marine communications and EMC review is relevant in Project engineering gate.
rows.nextAction: Acoustic modem integration, antenna/transducer mounting, cable shielding and data-loss behaviour.

rows.claim: PRESSURE-BOUNDARY-REVIEW: Depth-rated pressure boundary review is relevant in Project engineering gate.
rows.nextAction: Depth rating calculation, hull material allowables, endcap seal design and proof-pressure plan.

rows.claim: SUBSEA-LEAK-ABORT-REVIEW: Leak detection and abort-state review is relevant in Project engineering gate.
rows.nextAction: Leak sensor placement, abort state machine, battery isolation and recovery procedure.

rows.scope: Pressure hull or seal failure at depth
rows.claim: Pressure hull or seal failure at depth has provisional RPN 120 with mitigation: Depth-rated pressure calculation, hydrostatic proof test, leak test and seal inspection workflow.
rows.nextAction: Review severity, occurrence, detection and mitigation with a domain reviewer before publication.

rows.scope: Loss of navigation or communications underwater
rows.claim: Loss of navigation or communications underwater has provisional RPN 160 with mitigation: DVL/INS/depth fusion, acoustic link health monitoring and timed abort behaviour.
rows.nextAction: Review severity, occurrence, detection and mitigation with a domain reviewer before publication.

rows.scope: Unable to recover vehicle after abort
rows.claim: Unable to recover vehicle after abort has provisional RPN 96 with mitigation: Recovery beacon, drop-weight/recovery procedure, deck handling points and mission reserve energy.
